name: THE iDOLM@STER DearlyStars
source:
Taking place after the events of THE iDOLM@STER SP, the player sheds the title of producer and walks in the shoes of a brand-new idol. The fresh talent includes: Hidaka Ai, the hot-blooded but insecure daughter of a famous idol; Mizutani Eri, a timid hikikomori with a powerful internet following; and Akizuki Ryo, the cross-dressing cousin of 7650PRO'S Ritsuko. After completing every route, you will unlock a special epilogue. Your decisions both in the story and on stage will determine in you make it to the top.

While much more story oriented than previous titles, Dearly Stars still retains the Tension, Lesson, Promotion and Performance management of the mainline series.
translation:
故事发生在《偶像大师SP》之后。玩家将放下制作人的身份，以一名全新偶像的视角展开旅程。新晋偶像包括热情洋溢、却缺乏自信的知名偶像之女日高爱，在网络上拥有大量粉丝、却胆怯怕生的宅女水谷绘理，以及765事务所秋月律子的表弟、男扮女装的秋月凉。通关所有路线后，还可解锁特别后日谈。无论故事中的抉择，还是舞台上的决定，都将影响你能否登上顶峰。

虽然比起以往作品，《深情之星》更加注重故事，但仍保留了正传系列中情绪、课程、宣传与演出等方面的管理要素。
